subject: BIO
title: Biology – Form 2
source: Biology scheme of work for Form Two, 2026-2027

lessons.title: Need for reproduction; reproduction in plants; sexual reproduction in plants: from the flower to the seed and fruit; qualities of good grain: germination
Vegetative multiplication as the basis of cloning: natural (plantains, sugar cane, onion, potato, cocoyam) and artificial (grafting, marcotting, cutting, layering)
Other forms of asexual reproduction: budding in brewer's yeast, fission in bacteria
Reproduction in animals; sexual reproduction: fertilisation and development
Rearing techniques and animal husbandry: cycles of development, metamorphosis in insects and amphibians, impact of larval forms on plant yield

chapters.title: Module 1: Improving the quality and quantity of production

lessons.title: Prevention and elimination of parasites: ecto-parasites (lice, ticks, jiggers), endo-parasites (intestinal worms, plant parasites), semi-parasites (African mistletoe), complete parasites (mildew, rust, corn smut)
Biological and chemical control
Transformation of foodstuffs: role of micro-organisms in the transformation of foods (fermentation: alcohol, lactic acid and butyric acid)
Nutritional diseases due to poor feeding (obesity, kwashiorkor, beriberi, marasmus)
Body mass as an indication of overfeeding or underfeeding; other diseases (diabetes, hypertension...)
Calorific values of foods; project design to combat a deficiency or nutritional disease in the community
Food hygiene
Definition and importance of exercise to the body (muscles, brain, bones, body mass, blood circulation)
Practising work and recreational sports; definition and importance of rest to the body
Health and social effects of alcohol consumption, cigarette smoking and drug consumption on the body
Raising awareness of the health consequences of alcohol, cigarettes and drugs
Practices harmful to adolescent reproductive health
Emergent behaviour and reproductive health
STIs and HIV/AIDS as consequences of harmful sexual behaviour: gonorrhoea, syphilis, chlamydia, hepatitis B
HIV/AIDS; prevention of STIs and HIV/AIDS; hygiene of the reproductive organs

chapters.title: Module 3: Environmental education and sustainable development

lessons.title: Greenhouse effect and climate change: definition, causes, effects
Indicators of climate change and global warming
The ozone layer: definition, role, causes of destruction, prevention
Conservation of biodiversity: effects of civil engineering works, forest exploitation and intensive agriculture
Gardening (lawns, horticulture, green spaces); sustainable management of natural resources: water, air, soil; sensitisation and education
Common natural disasters in Cameroon: causes
Natural disasters: effects, impact and prevention
